newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Man shot attacking Ethiopian patriarch with sword.
newsitem.headline: Man shot attacking Ethiopian patriarch with sword.

text.p: A man tried to attack the Patriarch of the Ethiopian Orthodox Church with a sword during prayers on Thursday but was shot dead, Ethiopian police said.

Police arrested the man who killed the would-be assassin. The attempted attack on Patriarch Abune Paulso was carried out in Saint Stephan's Church in the Ethiopian capital Addis Ababa, a police official said. No further details were immediately available.
